Greetings from Sadiya College! Situated in the extreme eastern corner of Assam, Sadiya College is the lone seat of higher learning in the entire sub-division of Sadiya. It is a general degree college provincialized under Assam College Employee Provincialization Act No. XLVI of 2005. It isaffiliated to Dibrugarh University and recognized by University Grants Commission. The college was accredited by NAAC in the second cycle of accreditation with grade B in 2024. Right from its inception the College has held the pride in disseminating undergraduate education to the learners of this culturally diverse and vibrant area in all the three streams, i.e., Arts (1982), Commerce (2009) and Science (2020). It also offers various Certificate and Diploma courses under Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University, Guwahati in areas relevant to the emerging global trends. Endowed with a dedicated teaching faculty, Sadiya College aspires, in the coming days, to shine as an institution to reckon with and get reaccredited by NAAC.
The College is trying to provide adequate modern infrastructure with digital classrooms, laboratories, library, multi-purpose playground and canteen facilitiesin spite of all the challenges. It is worth mentioning that this landmasshad remained cut off, since time immemorial,from the rest of India by the rivers Lohit and Dibang, till two bridges were built over the rivers in 2015 and 2018 respectively. Since then, however, this area has witnessed some slow signs of development, and yes, like all other aspirations of the people of Sadiya, the developmental aspirations of the college too will take some time for getting fulfilled. In the meanwhile, the college authority is leaving no stone unturned to tap all possible resources with the sole purpose of developing Sadiya College into a modern, vibrant and reputed institute of higher learning.
It is also gearing up to implement Nation Education Policy 2020 under the watchful eyes of the authorities concerned.
Let\'s come together to develop ourselves into better human beings.
Dr. Bhupen Chutia, M.A., Ph.D
Principal, Sadiya College.
WELCOME TO SADIYA COLLEGE
Sadiya, one of the Sub-Division of Tinsukia District is a historically important place located on the extremely North-Eastern corner of Assam. It is geographically isolated by many rivers i.e. the mighty Brahmaputra, the Lohit and the river Dibang. The picturesque view of old Sadiya under the British was destroyed by the flood and the devastating great earthquake of 1950.
